Football Ted Lasso returns for its fourth season tonight and is sure to be a massive hit again. However, the latest data reveals the most-watched show on Apple TV+ this year so far, and it comes from the very same creator.

Shrinking has been the highest-viewed show on Apple TV+ so far in 2026 (Data: Nielsen)

Apple TV+ has never released official viewing figures for its shows and films. Closely monitoring the daily updated top 10 charts is the best way to gauge what audiences are watching.

In the streaming industry, withholding actual viewing data is common practice. However, among the many third-party companies that try to measure viewership, Nielsen has long been regarded as the industry gold standard.

Nielsen recently released its data for the first half of 2026, covering viewership across all streaming platforms.

Apple TV+ content rarely makes it onto Nielsen's charts, but one show—Shrinking, produced by the co-creator of Ted Lasso—just managed to squeeze into the top 20 of the "original series" viewership chart.

"Original series" refers to shows that premiere on streaming platforms. So classic shows with massive libraries, such as Grey's Anatomy and The Big Bang Theory, are not included.

According to Nielsen data, Shrinking ranked 20th on the original series chart with 5.2 billion minutes of viewing time, making it the most-watched show to have aired on Apple TV+ this year.

The show is in extremely tight competition with others hovering around the 5-billion-minute mark—such as Love Is Blind and Paradise. A slight uptick in viewership could see it climb as high as 14th place.

Stranger Things and The Pitt took the top two spots with 23 billion and 21 billion minutes of viewing time respectively.

For an Apple TV+ show, simply making it onto a Nielsen chart is quite an achievement. The new season of Ted Lasso will almost certainly rank highly too. What should please Apple (and viewers alike) is that Shrinking is expected to return next year for its fourth season.

Were you surprised by Nielsen's viewership rankings? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or you can subscribe at a discount via the Apple One bundle.
